verdict.rationale: xAI documents versioned model IDs (e.g. grok-4.7) alongside an explicit Model Aliases policy stating '<modelname> is aliased to the latest stable version' and '<modelname>-latest is aliased to the latest version', letting developers pin exact versions or track latest via alias. This is reinforced by the retirement/migration docs showing deprecated slugs auto-redirecting to newer versions. missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that alias resolution behaves as documented in practice, and more granular detail on how many prior versions remain pinnable long-term.
